ledger: Market street corridor | stalls line both sides of a straight pedestrian street receding to a distant vanishing point with red vendor umbrellas | layout unchanged at end | camera travels down-corridor, confirming a single consistent street axis

Left-row stalls (stall side) | red awnings, hanging Edison bulbs, hanging tomato/pepper strings; up-street produce: green apples in dark crates, boxed tomatoes | down-street section revealed: oranges in red crate, teal produce in blue crate, purple trays, limes in white boxes, packaged-goods tables | produce sequence appears in strict forward-travel order with no reordering or mirroring; hanging bulbs/strings stay on this row throughout

Right-row stalls | red awnings, blue crate of green produce, boxed apples in up-street section | down-street section: purple trays with oranges, greens, white boxes of apples/tomatoes | consistent forward progression; always opposite the left row across the street

Subject (woman, blue umbrella, red apple) | walking down-street toward camera position, left-row stalls on her left | continues down-street away from camera, same side of street | continuous walk; no teleportation or side-swapping relative to stalls

Camera path | starts ahead of subject facing her (front view) | orbits to her right side (profile, down-street = frame right) then settles behind her (back view) | orbit direction is geometrically coherent: left-row stalls transition frame-left foreground → background across frame → frame-left again; down-street pedestrians appear frame-right in profile phase as required

Light-blue-shirt pedestrian | enters left foreground, browses left stall, turns, walks down-street ahead of subject | seen from behind further down-street | trajectory continuous and physically plausible
White-shirt man | enters left foreground near camera, walks down-street along stall front | ahead of subject, seen from behind in right background | consistent overtake-and-recede motion
Blue-t-shirt man | enters left foreground mid-sequence | ahead of subject walking away down-street | plausible faster same-direction walker
Glasses man (light blue polo) | standing at left-row packaged-goods stall | crosses behind subject toward right row as she passes | fast but physically possible crossing; not flagged

Occlusion ordering | foreground passersby and umbrella canopy correctly occlude subject/stalls; stalls occlude street background; no background-over-foreground inversions observed | same ordering maintained at end | occlusion edges track motion smoothly
